controller_mappings.title: single-set-alternative :: always-gyro :: 90.32
controller_mappings.description:
Keyboard & mouse layout with WASD movement, gyro aiming, and right-stick turn assist. L1/R1 fire left/right mouse buttons; L2/R2 are the modifiers. Hold Start or Select for the Fn layers. While either is held the camera stick is off, and Fn waits while a stick is pushed to its rim.

Configure normal gyro and right-stick response in Base; modifier and ramp layers have their own stick overrides. The empty left-stick edge bind is the WASD Modifier slot. Ramp Up 0 and Ramp Up 1, the first two layers, control turn-assist speed and timing.

Temp Cursor Gyro: hold either modifier for 200 ms, or lift a thumb from either stick during the hold, for cursor response. The 200 ms hold gives a high-intensity haptic pulse; thumb-lift entry stays silent. Ongoing gyro vibration is off and minimum movement threshold is 5. Face buttons, D-pad, stick clicks, Start/Select, the opposite modifier, or both sticks pushed to the rim cancel cursor response for the rest of that hold. Release and hold again to re-enable it.

Steering (Deck testing pending): hold Start, click and release the left stick, then release Start. A beep and a strong pulse confirm it. The left stick drives with WASD. Hold R2 for W or L2 for S; the left stick then steers with A/D. While driving, hold the left stick down or up for the L2 or R2 modifier map. It stays while the stick rolls sideways and ends when the stick returns to center. A quick flick back to center scrolls once instead, and a second flick held keeps scrolling. Hold the other trigger for the two-modifier map, where left stick up/down scrolls. A quick tap of the other trigger clears every layer, including Gyro, back to Base. Releasing the driving trigger hands over to the other one if it is held; otherwise the left stick returns to WASD. Holding it up or down pulses for one second; after that second, letting it go leaves Steering, with the beep. Letting it go, or rolling to A or D, inside the second keeps Steering. Inside that second the triggers scroll and Start and Select type Tab and Escape; after it, or if one is still held when it ends, a trigger, Start or Select also leaves Steering. Start and Select send Tab and Escape while driving, and after entering until the left stick has been moved once; otherwise they keep their taps and Fn layers. To leave Steering, hold Start or Select, click and release either stick, then release the button, with the same beep and pulse; Gyro stays as it was. While steering, right-pad touch modes such as circular scroll are off, so the pad is just the mouse, and right-stick turn assist is off, so the gyro also stays on while the right stick turns.

Trackpad clicks (Deck testing pending): a click is read once, when it starts, and holds until release. Pressed near the centre, the right pad is the middle mouse button, and the cursor still moves while it is held; the left pad is Caps Lock. Further out, the right pad is Back, Forward and scroll up/down, and the left pad is the arrow keys. The centre click comes at once and the outer buttons 5 ms later; where the two ranges meet, the centre wins.

Cursor Gyro (Deck testing pending): hold Select, click and release the right stick, then release Select, with the same beep and pulse. It turns Gyro on if it was off, and the gyro keeps the Temp Cursor Gyro response until you leave. Right-stick turn assist is off while it is on. To leave, hold Start or Select, click and release either stick, then release the button; or push both sticks out, which beeps. Both leave Gyro on. A quick L2+R2 tap clears every layer, including Gyro, back to Base. While a modifier or a menu button is held, pushing both sticks out does what it always did; Cursor Gyro then ends when the button is let go, if both sticks are still out.

Gamepad (Deck testing pending): hold Start, click and release the right stick, then release Start; or do the same with Select and the left stick. The same beep and pulse confirm it. Every control is then a gamepad control: both sticks and their clicks, D-pad, face buttons, bumpers and analog triggers. L5 is B, R5 is Y, L4 is the left-stick click and R4 is A. A click of the left pad is Select and of the right pad is Start, at once. On the Start and Select buttons a tap sends the button about 200 ms later, a double press holds it for as long as the second press is held, and a hold sends nothing and gives a light pulse after 200 ms. To leave, hold Start or Select, click either stick, then release the button, with the same beep and pulse; Gyro is as it was. The L2+R2 tap does not leave Gamepad. Gyro and the keyboard and mouse layers are off while it is on.

Menu Keys (Deck testing pending): hold Select and Start together for 200 ms. A beep and a strong pulse confirm it, and Gyro turns off. The D-pad is the arrow keys, and A, B, X and Y are Enter, Escape, Backspace and Tab. L2 and R2, Start, Select and the stick-touch gestures do nothing; everything else works as in Base. To leave: push both sticks out; or push one stick and press a face button or a D-pad direction, which then counts as a normal press; or hold Start or Select and click either stick, then release the button, with the same beep and pulse. Outside Menu Keys, with Select held a tap of Start types Enter, and with Start held a tap of Select types Backspace. A double tap and hold holds the key. Every press of the second button works this way while the first is held. Inside Steering and Cursor Gyro the second button types its key at once.

Base and Gyro (L2+R2 toggle) retain their activation rules.

english.title: Gamepad
english.description: This template is for games that already have built-in gamepad support.  Intended for dual stick games such as twin-stick shooters, side-scrollers, etc.

czech.title: Gamepad
czech.description: Tato šablona je pro většinu her podporujících gamepad a byla navržena pro použití ve hrách využívajících dvě páčky, jakými jsou například plošinovky nebo automatové hry.

danish.title: Gamepad
danish.description: Denne skabelon er til spil, der allerede har indbygget gamepad-understøttelse. Beregnet til spil med dobbelte styrepinde såsom twin-stick shooters, side-scrollers osv.

dutch.title: Gamepad
dutch.description: Deze template is voor spellen die al ingebouwde gamepadondersteuning hebben. Bedoeld voor dual-stick spellen zoals twin-stick-shooters, side-scrollers, etc.

finnish.title: Ohjain
finnish.description: Tämä malli on muita ohjaimia valmiiksi tukeville peleille. Se on tarkoitettu kahta sauvaa käyttäville peleille, kuten twin-stick shooterit, side-scrollerit, jne.

french.title: Manette
french.description: Ce modèle fonctionne pour les jeux conçus pour manettes à deux sticks tels que les jeux de type twin-stick shooter, à défilement horizontal (side-scrollers), etc.

german.title: Gamepad
german.description: Diese Vorlage ist für Spiele konzipiert, die bereits volle Unterstützung für Gamepads mit sich bringen. Gedacht für Zwei-Analogstick-Spiele wie Twin-Stick-Shooter, Side-Scrollers usw.

hungarian.title: Gamepad
hungarian.description: Ez a sablon olyan játékokhoz való, melyek már rendelkeznek beépített gamepad-támogatással. Olyan két karos játékokhoz szánva, mint a kétkaros vagy oldalnézetes lövöldözős játékok stb.

italian.title: Controller
italian.description: Questo modello funziona per la maggior parte dei giochi che supportano i controller in modalità nativa.

japanese.title: ゲームパッド
japanese.description: このテンプレートは、標準でゲームパッドをサポートしているツインスティックシューターや横スクロール等といったデュアルスティックゲームを対象としたゲーム向けです。

koreana.title: 게임패드
koreana.description: 게임 패드를 지원하도록 설계된 게임들을 위한 설정입니다. 이중 스틱 슈팅 게임, 사이드 스크롤 게임 등 스틱을 두 개 쓰는 게임을 염두에 두고 만들어졌습니다.

polish.title: Kontroler
polish.description: Ten szablon jest odpowiedni dla gier, które już mają wbudowane wsparcie dla kontrolerów. Przeznaczony dla gier obsługujących dwie gałki, m.in. twin-stick shootery, side-scrollery itp.

portuguese.title: Comando
portuguese.description: Este modelo é indicado para jogos que já têm compatibilidade nativa com comando. Foi concebido para jogos de tiros que usam dois sticks, jogos de plataformas, de naves, etc.

romanian.title: Gamepad
romanian.description: Șablonul acesta este pentru jocurile care au deja suport pentru gamepad implementat. Destinat pentru jocuri dual stick, precum shooter-e twin-stick, side-scroller, etc.

russian.title: Геймпад
russian.description: Этот шаблон подходит для большинства игр с поддержкой геймпада — например, для шутеров с видом сверху или сбоку.

spanish.title: Mando
spanish.description: Esta plantilla es para juegos que ya incluyen de serie compatibilidad con mando. Está destinada a juegos de doble stick como twin-stick shooters, side-scrollers, etc.

swedish.title: Gamepad
swedish.description: Denna mall är för spel som redan har inbyggt stöd för spelkontroller. Avsett för spel som använder två styrspakar, som twin-stick shooters och side-scrollers, etc.

schinese.title: 手柄
schinese.description: 该模板适用于已内置手柄支持的游戏。针对双摇杆游戏，如双摇杆射击游戏、横版过关游戏等设计。

brazilian.title: Controle padrão
brazilian.description: Este modelo é para jogos já compatíveis com controle que usam ambas as alavancas, como jogos de nave, etc.

bulgarian.title: Геймпад
bulgarian.description: Този шаблон е за игри, които вече имат вградена поддръжка на геймпад. Предназначен e за игри ползващи двата стика. Като например, екшъни за два аналогови стика, странични скролери и т.н.

greek.title: Χειριστήριο
greek.description: Αυτό το πρότυπο ορίζεται για παιχνίδια τα οποία έχουν ήδη υποστήριξη χειριστηρίου. Προορίζεται για παιχνίδια dual-stick όπως twin-stick shooters, side-scrollers, κλπ.

turkish.title: Oyun Kumandası
turkish.description: Bu şablon hali hazırda oyun içi oyun kumandası desteği ve birincil veya üçüncü kişi kontrollü kameraya sahip oyunlar içindir. Çift çubuk kullanılan oyunlar olan ikiz çubuk nişancılık, side-scroller oyunlar vb. içindir.

ukrainian.title: Ґеймпад
ukrainian.description: Цей шаблон для більшості ігор, в яких вже вбудовано підтримку ґеймпада. Призначено для ігор з керуванням двома стіками.
